def factor_intraday_exhaustion_pct_vol(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_pct = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct=True)
    is_high, is_low, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    signal = -intraday_ret * range_pct * vol_ratio
    signal_ema = signal.ewm(span=3, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_intraday_exhaustion_pct_vol"] = signal_ema.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_exhaustion_pct_vol"]
description: Panic selling exhaustion signal. A negative intraday return indicates intraday decline. Range percentile (rolling 20-day rank) captures extreme daily ranges relative to recent history, bounded for robustness. The volume ratio from alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime (EMA-based) identifies elevated volume conditions. Multiplying these three components amplifies exhaustion signals. A 3-day EMA smooths noise. This mutation replaces manual z-score and volume ratio with more robust and reusable modules, targeting improved mutual information while preserving rank stability.
